text:
Mia Chen: dropping a compact mock for the usage dashboard — trying to squeeze org + project context into one card, want quick takes. link: https://drive.redwood/example-spend-compact.png :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Devon Patel: nice, can we keep the token breakdown visible without expanding? that's been a common ask from platform teams
Raja Iyer: agree. prefer a small inline sparkline for timeline and a micro table for tokens (model / count / cost) so it's readable at a glance
Sasha L: question — when the org/project toggle is on the top, do we lose context of which org? maybe add a tiny breadcrumb or chip showing active org
Olivia Park: +1 on breadcrumb. Also, accessibility: contrast on the grey micro-table is low. Need WCAG AA for 14px body copy
Mia Chen: good call. I'll bump contrast and test with 4.5:1. Also, wireframe idea: have the invoice CTA as a small icon instead of full text when width < 480px
Eli (PM): caution w/ icon-only CTA — customers asked for clear download affordance in support threads. Could be icon with tooltip on hover / longpress on mobile
Devon Patel: another tradeoff: sparkline vs stacked area for spend split. Sparkline is compact but hides per-model spikes. Stacked area shows composition but is heavier visually
Raja Iyer: what about toggling density? default compact = sparkline + hover breakdown, expand = stacked area + legend. Keeps both audiences happy
Sasha L: here's a quick copy tweak for the tokens header: change "Token Breakdown" -> "Token cost by model" (more descriptive for new users)
Olivia Park: also change aria-labels: currently chart uses `aria-label="usage-chart"` which is vague. propose `aria-label="monthly spend and token breakdown chart"`
Mia Chen: will update mocks. small code snippet for the tooltip we can use: ```json
{"label":"Model","tokens":"count","cost":"usd"}
```
DesignBot: accessibility scan: micro-table contrast at 0.37 fails. chart interactive elements missing keyboard focus states.
Eli (PM): prioritization: must meet AA contrast for table + clear invoice CTA before next release. Sparkline/stacked toggle is nice-to-have for MVP
Devon Patel: UX nit — when switching org -> project, keep the timeline fixed, don't reset date range. It's jarring when context jumps
Mia Chen: noted. I'll make date range sticky per user. Also will try the breadcrumb + icon CTA approach, and update copy & aria labels
Raja Iyer: one more: for customers with many projects, the org-level card should show top 3 projects with a "show more" overflow instead of cramming microbars
Sasha L: thumbs up. Overflow with a lightweight modal could work. Ensure modal has focus trap and close btn with accessible label
Olivia Park: last one — invoice download file name should include org slug + date, e.g., `redwood-inc-2025-03-invoice.csv` for traceability in accounting
Mia Chen: excellent. I'll push an updated Figma and link back here when done. thanks for the fast feedback :slightly_smiling_face:
